messages:
Zara (Security): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about partner onboarding for SOC2/ISO. We agreed to publish a concise partner playbook.

Owen (CTO): Good. Focus areas: BYOK/KMS expectations, VPC connectivity snapshots, audit log export format & retention, and the minimal artifacts pack for auditors.

Mira (Compliance): Minimal artifacts: system diagram, control owners, access review sample, key rotation evidence, and a signed shared-controls attestation. ISO reviewers will also want key lifecycle details and algorithms.

Dex (Infra): We can produce daily JSONL audit exports to partner buckets. Proposed path: partners/<partner-id>/audit/YYYYMMDD.jsonl. Each record: ts, req_id, principal, action, resource, success.

Finn (DevRel): I'll draft the partner README and a short onboarding checklist with sample commands. ETA: 7 business days.

Zara (Security): Action items: Finn - README/checklist due 2024-10-22; Dex - log export spec + manifest due 2024-10-18; Owen/Product - BYOK acceptance criteria due 2024-10-16; Mira - artifact checklist due 2024-10-20.

Owen (CTO): Confirmed. Suggest pilot with BeaconLabs to validate flow.

calendar-bot: "Partner Onboarding Office Hours" weekly, starting 2024-10-09, Wednesdays 11:00-11:30 PT.

Zara (Security): I'll create the doc at go/internal/partner-playbook and post the link when ready. Thanks everyone!
